name: Animated Number Counter
description: Animate leaderboard values with a lightweight, reusable number tween utility.
details: A small server-side helper that smoothly animates a player's displayed score when their value changes. It works well for coins, points and other leaderboard stats.

scripts.name: AnimatedCounter.server.lua
scripts.description: Creates a score value and animates updates.

instructions: Replace the sample score update with your reward logic.
Use a client UI for per-player visual effects in production.
notes: The example prints intermediate values; adapt the update callback to your UI.
